description:
Company Profile

LSEG is home to an exciting Markets business. As one of LSEG's core strengths, and with people at our centre, Markets is crucial to enabling LSEGs mission. Today we are working to improve the critical systems which underpin the services that London Stock Exchange provides. We are offering a front row seat to the rise of Fintech and digitalisation of the Financial Industry.

 

We take pride in our teams and are an equal opportunity employer. Our colleagues' backgrounds and experiences are as varied as the solutions they provide. Flexible working opportunities, a keen sense of community, and a collective mission to deliver our cloud first initiative, makes this a hugely rewarding place to work.

 

Unlike many organisations, most of our technology solutions are developed and delivered in-house. This internal expertise allows us to understand the diverse needs of our business and use modern methodologies to meet them. Just like our industry, we are constantly evolving and there has never been a more exciting time for you to join!

 

Role Profile

The role is within the Data Factory team which sits within the Application Services Division. We strive for our engineers to work within small, agile, self-managed teams that emphasise best practice and believe quality is everyone’s responsibility. They bring an enthusiastic “you build it you run it” mindset whilst making sure they share their knowledge while removing constraints.

 

You will have the opportunity to work on our cloud first initiative contributing to how we design, build, and implement cloud solutions. It goes hand in hand that troubleshooting, enhancing the environments, and ensuring service availability will be a key part of this role.

         

Tech Profile

AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Anthos, Kubernetes, ECR, Kafka ,Snowflake, Datadog, Big Panda, GitLab, Scripting Technologies (Bash / Python / PowerShell), Control-M, Jira, Confluence.

 

We are looking for someone who:

  • has a passion for architecting and building AWS cloud native solutions
  • has experience in automating infrastructure provisioning and application deployment
  • understands and can implement Infrastructure as Code patterns and practices
  • can build CI/CD pipelines orchestrating the promotion of code
  • can define and implement cloud native operational requirements
  • understands the importance of observability and has experience in implementing cloud alerting solutions
  • has an open and collaborative mindset keeping artifacts up to date and relevant while actively promoting knowledge sharing

 

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.


Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

 

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.


Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

 

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.


Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.


By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.


If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.


LSEG. Make more possible.
